Definition: from G1223 and G5442; to guard thoroughly, i.e. protect:--keep.
BiblicalUsage: To keep safe through danger is what the angels are charged to do, and the word stands once, in the psalm the devil quotes to Jesus. He shall give His angels charge over thee, to keep thee, and the promise is that they will bear Him up in their hands.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the devil's quoting of this verse is the warning to handle Scripture rightly; the promise is true — God does keep His own — but it is not a licence to throw oneself off the pinnacle to prove it.
